title: Eval-change noticeflow orchestration and deduplicated alerting
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Problem statement: We currently surface eval regressions to Slack and PagerDuty as individual alerts with limited context. During large rollouts or config churn this produces alert storms and noisy on-call pages, making it hard to triage real quality regressions. Goal: Build an orchestration layer that binds eval-change events to the deployment/config-change context, computes a notification fidelity score, and emits compact, deduplicated notifications to Console-integrated channels (Slack threads + PagerDuty incidents) with enriched payloads (sample failing prompts, rollout id, config diff).

Scope: UI surface in Console (timeline + delta heatmap), backend event correlator (config-diff trigger -> group eval failures), routing rules (severity mapping, per-customer mute windows, burst dampening), and integrations for Slack and PagerDuty with dedupe/hash envelopes. Not in scope: automated rollbacks or model-serving instrumentation beyond linking to existing telemetry dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows an eval-change event grouped under the originating rollout with a delta heatmap and top failing prompts.
Slack integration posts a single thread per logical regression (grouped by rollout + model variant) with automatic summary and attachments, not >1 thread per minute for the same regression.
PagerDuty incidents are created for high-severity grouped regressions with escalation policies; duplicate incidents are suppressed for the same regression signature.
On-call engineers can ack/mute the grouped alert which prevents repeated pages for the same regression fingerprint for the configurable window.
Metrics emitted: grouped_alert_rate, dedupe_hit_ratio, average_time_to_ack for grouped alerts.
success_metrics: Reduce on-call pages for eval regressions by >=60% during active rollouts (measured over 30 days).
Dedupe hit ratio >= 0.7 for config-change-triggered events in first 4 weeks.
Median time-to-first-action after grouped alert <= 15 minutes for high-severity regressions.
implementation_steps: 1) Define event schema for eval-change + rollout metadata (author, rollout_id, config_diff_hash, model_variant).
2) Build correlator service (k/v store for active rollouts) that ingests eval signals and computes regression fingerprints and a notification fidelity score.
3) Add dedupe hashing algorithm: stable hash over (rollout_id, model_variant, metric_bucket, top_n_failure_hashes).
4) Wire Slack adapter to create a single thread per fingerprint and append subsequent hits as thread messages; attach sample prompts and links to failing eval cases.
5) Wire PagerDuty adapter to create incidents only when fidelity score + severity crosses threshold; ensure subsequent hits trigger notes on the same incident instead of new ones.
6) Expose config in Console UI for routing rules, per-customer mute windows, and fidelity thresholds.
7) Add e2e tests and an incident storm simulation to validate backoff/dampening behavior.
8) Run gradual rollout (canary to internal teams -> opt-in customers -> global).
rollout_plan: Week 0: Feature flag behind 'eval_noticeflow_v1' and internal dogfood with Platform SRE and a subset of customers.
Week 2: Enable Slack thread grouping for internal rollouts and collect dedupe metrics; monitor dedupe_hit_ratio and false suppression rate.
Week 4: Enable PagerDuty creation for severity >= P0/P1 with short escalation window for on-call teams participating in pilot.
Week 6: Open opt-in in Console for customers; default remains conservative thresholds.
Full GA: flip default thresholds after 8 weeks of stable pilot metrics.
monitoring_and_alerting: Emit telemetry: grouped_alerts.total, grouped_alerts.unique_fingerprints, dedupe.hit_ratio, fidelity.score_distribution, grouped_alerts.false_suppression_estimate.
Create Console dashboard tile for event storms (spikes in grouped_alerts.unique_fingerprints) and a timeline of rollouts with correlated grouped_alert events.
Add PagerDuty escalation metrics mapping for grouped alerts and alert routing logs to S3 for audit.
comments: 2026-02-21 — Kickoff: aligned with SRE on correlator ownership; SRE recommends using existing rollout index service.
2026-02-28 — Design review: UX iterated to include 'why this alert' card showing config_diff and sample failures (action: design to deliver microcopy).
2026-03-03 — Engineering estimate: ENG asks to split dedupe logic into library to reuse for other alerting paths (accepted).
2026-03-05 — Security: reviewed payload attachments for PII; decided to hash user identifiers and include only anonymized prompt snippets (action: security to provide scrub rules).
2026-03-09 — PM/Eng sync: reduced initial fidelity threshold to be conservative; will increase after pilot if noise low.
